name: pdf-cli
description: pdf-cli: a guide that teaches an agent to read PDFs with the pdf command

plugins.name: pdf-cli
plugins.description: Teaches a coding agent to read PDFs on a Mac with the pdf command: a map of the file, only the pages it needs, search, crops of tables and figures, and flags on what it could not read well. Local; nothing is uploaded. Needs pdf on the PATH.
